facts.fact: The Public Utilities Regulatory Authority (PURA) invited licensees, sector ministries, industry stakeholders, consumer groups, civil society organisations and the general public to comment on draft instruments including the Broadcasting and Online Content Regulations, 2026 and the Journalists Registration Guidelines, 2026, with a consultation window of 1 to 10 April 2026.

note: Notice only promises that responses will be published on the PURA website; no published comments or answer are stated, so no answered fact.
